title: VPN Connection Troubleshooting
content: Check internet connectivity. Restart the VPN client. Verify username and password. Clear VPN cache. Restart the computer. If the VPN still fails, check firewall and network configuration.

title: Password Reset
content: Open the company password portal. Select Forgot Password. Verify employee identity. Enter a new password. Confirm the password and login again.

title: Email Not Working
content: Check internet connectivity. Verify mailbox storage. Restart Outlook. Remove and re-add the email account. Check SMTP and IMAP settings.

title: Printer Not Printing
content: Check printer power and network connection. Verify printer status. Clear the print queue. Restart the print spooler. Reinstall the printer driver if required.

title: Slow Computer
content: Restart the computer. Check CPU and memory usage. Close unnecessary applications. Remove temporary files. Check available disk space. Run antivirus scanning.
